title: My Grandpa's Rule: Feed The Scarecrow Before Dark
cta: Tag a friend who always forgets their chores
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you have broken the rule? Tell us in the comments.
lines: My grandpa has one rule on the farm.
Feed the scarecrow before dark. One bowl of rice. Every night.
I thought it was a joke for little kids.
That night, it was standing at my window.
I shut my eyes and counted to a hundred.
In the morning, I came down for breakfast.
*The scarecrow was sitting in my chair.
And Mum called it by my name.
Then she looked right through me.
